trace.final:
I rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all regions, and it's passing health checks again. I also opened SEV2 incident INC-0001, which paged on-call.

- **Rollback:** v2.3.1 was failing health checks with an 18% error rate. v2.3.0 was the most recent release that had been healthy in production, so no change-manager approval was needed. I rolled it out to us-east, us-west and eu-west.
- **Check after rollback:** all three regions are on v2.3.0, and the error rate is down to 0.2%.
- **Incident:** INC-0001 is open. The first attempt to create it timed out. I confirmed no incident had been created, then retried with the same idempotency key, so only one incident was opened. It describes the failure, the rollback and the current health. It notes that v2.3.1 and the earlier v2.3.1-rc build are both marked unhealthy and need a root-cause fix before v2.3.1 is deployed again.
